name: idle-claude-prompt
captured_by: built by hand on the layout of a capture from a live agent pane
note: An idle claude REPL prompt. The layout (a recap, a numbered list with prose after it, the turn's timer, an interrupted-command notice, the empty input box and a two-row statusline) and herdr's rule evaluation over it are from a read-only capture of a live agent's pane that the capturing agent had not started; the transcript text, title, statusline values and cwd are synthetic, and the explain previews are re-cut from the rebuilt screen.
